verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, and session timeouts is a fair question for a government online-filing portal, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such disclosure. The only related item is a service-unavailability notice for customs and IEC/ISV systems. That is an adjacent downtime announcement and does not publish operating-hours windows, daily limits, or session-timeout rules for the filing flow.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
